<?xml version='1.0' encoding='utf-8'?> <mxGraphModel adaptiveColors="auto" page="0"><root><mxCell id="0" /><mxCell id="1" parent="0" /><mxCell id="record" value="运行记录
事件与停止原因" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#F3EEFF;strokeColor=#B9A6F0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=16;fontColor=#1B1F24;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry as="geometry" x="30" y="30" width="160" height="60" /></mxCell><mxCell id="files" value="当前文件
按任务核对内容" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#F3EEFF;strokeColor=#B9A6F0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=16;fontColor=#1B1F24;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry as="geometry" x="30" y="160" width="160" height="60" /></mxCell><mxCell id="checks" value="evaluate()
停止、调用、文件" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#EEF4FF;strokeColor=#9DB8F2;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=16;fontColor=#1B1F24;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry as="geometry" x="270" y="30" width="160" height="60" /></mxCell><mxCell id="event" value="本题需要的事件
copy：读取成功
denied：拒绝" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#EEF4FF;strokeColor=#9DB8F2;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=16;fontColor=#1B1F24;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry as="geometry" x="270" y="150" width="160" height="80" /></mxCell><mxCell id="all" value="全部满足？" style="rhombus;fillColor=#FFF6E0;strokeColor=#E8C36A;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=16;fontColor=#1B1F24;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry as="geometry" x="510" y="30" width="160" height="90" /></mxCell><mxCell id="yes" value="通过
passed = true" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#E7F6EC;strokeColor=#8BCB9F;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=16;fontColor=#1B1F24;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry as="geometry" x="730" y="30" width="140" height="60" /></mxCell><mxCell id="no" value="未通过
passed = false" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#FDECEC;strokeColor=#EBA3A3;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=16;fontColor=#1B1F24;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry as="geometry" x="730" y="160" width="140" height="60" /></mxCell><mxCell id="sample" value="DeepEval 样本
任务、回答、工具" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#F3EEFF;strokeColor=#B9A6F0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=16;fontColor=#1B1F24;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry as="geometry" x="30" y="300" width="190" height="60" /></mxCell><mxCell id="note" value="保留 checks 解释原因
样本构造不自动评分" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#EEF4FF;strokeColor=#9DB8F2;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=16;fontColor=#1B1F24;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry as="geometry" x="510" y="300" width="300" height="60" /></mxCell><mxCell id="a" source="record" target="checks" value="读取记录" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#687D93;fontSize=13;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;" edge="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1" /></mxCell><mxCell id="b" source="files" target="checks" value="读取产物" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#687D93;fontSize=13;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;entryX=0;entryY=0.8;" edge="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1" /></mxCell><mxCell id="c" source="checks" target="event" value="选择本题事件" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#687D93;fontSize=13;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;" edge="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1" /></mxCell><mxCell id="d" source="event" target="all" value="汇总 checks" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#687D93;fontSize=13;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;entryX=0.5;entryY=1;" edge="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1" /></mxCell><mxCell id="e" source="all" target="yes" value="是" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#687D93;fontSize=13;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;" edge="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1" /></mxCell><mxCell id="f" source="all" target="no" value="否" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#687D93;fontSize=13;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;exitX=1;exitY=0.8;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;" edge="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1" /></mxCell><mxCell id="g" source="record" target="sample" value="" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#687D93;fontSize=13;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;exitX=0;exitY=0.5;entryX=0;entryY=0.5;" edge="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1" /></mxCell><mxCell id="h" source="yes" target="note" value="保留逐项判断" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#687D93;fontSize=13;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;exitX=1;exitY=0.5;entryX=1;entryY=0.4;" edge="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1" /></mxCell><mxCell id="i" source="no" target="note" value="" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#687D93;fontSize=13;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;entryX=0.8;entryY=0;" edge="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1" /></mxCell></root></mxGraphModel>
